== Trivia == *Shortly after the event started, the NPC was disabled on the main network but not on the Alpha Network. On the Alpha Network, there was a bug that allowed players to get multiple hats by switching hubs. All hats claimed by each player were always the same color, regardless of network. A few minutes after the event started, the NPC on the main server was enabled for a few minutes with the same bug, but it was disabled again after a few more minutes. The bug was fixed on the alpha network after just over 20 minutes, and the fix was pushed to the main network about 60 minutes later. Players who claimed a Balloon Hat during the bug were able to claim another when the NPC was enabled after the bug was fixed. *If player equips more than one Balloon Hat, only one of them will give stat bonus, resulting in only {{Green|+1}} {{stat|mf}} bonus. *Hatcessories are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2024/June 10|[[File:Red 5th Anniversary Balloon Hat.png|26px]] Added '''5th Anniversary Balloon Hat'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Accessories}} {{Nav/Armors}}

{{Quest|Recover Sulphur}} |abiphone = Yes |location = [[Mage Council]] |location_page_description = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to discuss stolen research. |x = -121.5 |y = 82 |z = -756.5 |location2 = [[Burning Desert]] |location_page_description2 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to find the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x2 = -526.5 |y2 = 86 |z2 = -885.5 |location3 = [[Crimson Isle]] |location_page_description3 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] next to the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x3 = -522.86 |y3 = 104 |z3 = -918.8 |minimap_location3 = Burning Desert |location4 = The Wasteland |location_page_description4 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]]. |x4 = -373.5 |y4 = 117 |z4 = -977.5 |location5 = Forgotten Skull |location_page_description5 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] after defeating [[Kuudra]]. |x5 = -373.5 |y5 = 113 |z5 = -1036.5 }} '''Captain Ahone''' is an [[NPC]] found throughout the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} primarily during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], as well as at the end of both [[Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questlines]]. == Quest == '''Captain Ahone''' first appears during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] when the player is sent to the {{Zone|Mage Council}} to meet about stolen research. Later in the quest, he appears in the {{Zone|Burning Desert}} with a {{Item|Small Backpack}}, after {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with finding the lost {{NPCSprite|Apprentice (Crimson Isle);Apprentice}}. Their [[Abiphone]] contact gets added to the player's Abiphone, instructing them to call upon finding the Apprentice. When this happens, he then walks up to the Apprentice with {{NPCSprite|Grelius}} and {{NPCSprite|Krevius}}, splashes him with healing potions, and then disappears, tasking the player player with reporting back to {{NPCSprite|Dean}}. Towards the end of the quest, {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with calling Captain Ahone, who then instructs the player to meet them by the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}. He can then be found there with several other [[NPCs]], who all agree to investigate [[Kuudra]]. This ending also occurs at the end of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. After defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time as part of either quest, they then appear in the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}} with {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} and {{NPCSprite|Elle}}, disappearing after you continue the quest. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Dialogue |- | class="ct" | During the {{Zone|Mage Council}} meeting | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: Oh, &7 &fis here! They're the one who retrieved the research! &e[NPC] &d&lQueen Nyx&f: I see, we owe you adventurer, this object is of great value to us. &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: Yes indeed! You wizards have some nerves! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside. }} |- | class="ct" | After defeating [[Kuudra]] | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You too &7&f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll also alert our Chief. In 2022, [[Simon]] appeared during the [[SkyBlock Anniversary|{{Pink|SkyBlock Anniversary}}]] near the {{zone|Colosseum}} to distribute '''Crab Hat of Celebration - 2022 Edition'''s, which were animated unlike their 2020 counterpart. === Game Message === {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Message |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Collecting Crab Hat | class="ct" | 2020 |{{Dialogue|&eSimon gave a &7[color] Crab Hat&e to &7&e!}} |- | class="ct" | 2022 |{{Dialogue|&eSimon gave a &7[Color] Crab Hat of Celebration - 2022 Edition &eto &7&e!}} |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Attempting to claim another Crab Hat | class="ct" | 2020 |{{Dialogue|&eYou have already collected a hat for this year!}} |- | class="ct" | 2022 |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Simon: &fI've already given you a Crab Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!}} |} == Usage == {{:Hatcessories/Effect}} Additionally, the '''Crab Hat of Celebration''' gives the following cosmetic effect when worn: * Rainbow potion particles appear around the player. * Fireworks occasionally launch from the player's head. * For the 2022 Edition, the texture is animated. See [[#Gallery|§ Gallery]] below. == Trivia == * The color of the hat was randomly selected when it was claimed, like the [[Century Cake]] or the expression of [[Sloth Hat of Celebration]]. * The party hats worn by the crabs were white in 2020 and black in 2022. * Players can only acquire a Crab Hat on one [[profile]]. * Black Crab Hats are generally worth more on the [[Auction House]] because they are more visually pleasing, and the name blends in with the background in the tooltip. * The Crab Hats, [[Sloth Hat of Celebration|Sloth Hats]], and the [[Pulse Ring]] are the only [[Accessory|Accessories]] that give {{stat|mf}} without [[Enrichments]]. * As a {{Special}} accessory, the Crab Hat can be [[Enrichments|enriched]]. * When the 2022 edition was released, the stats, enrichments, and [[Accessory Power]] of different editions stacked with each other. ** The stacking has been removed since a certain point before Aug 19, 2022. * The amount of {{stat|int}} gained depends only on the number of [[Time|SkyBlock years]] that have passed since the player created their oldest profile, regardless of the player's activity during this time. The current maximum, which applies to players who joined during the first SkyBlock year, is {{SkyClock}}. * The Crab Hat was the first {{Special}} accessory. * Hatccessories are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". == Gallery ==

'''Lasea''' is an [[NPC]] in {{Zone|Dragontail}}. During the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], she tasks the player with obtaining a {{Item|Skeleton Fish}} and {{Item|Flyfish}}.

== Quest ==
After killing the {{MobSprite|Magma Boss}} for {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} as part of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], '''Lasea''' will ask the player to bring her 1 {{Item|Skeleton Fish}} and 1 {{Item|Flyfish}}. After they are brought these items, the player will be rewarded with {{Reputation|Barbarian|100}}, and then tasked with speaking to {{NPCSprite|Gris}} to continue the quest.

Happy Anniversary!}} |} == Usage == {{:Hatcessories/Effect}} ==Trivia== *The expression of the hat was randomly selected when it was claimed, like the color of [[Century Cake]] and [[Crab Hat of Celebration]]. *The Grumpy expression is a reference to Grumpy Cat, a popular meme from the 2010's. * Players could only acquire a Sloth Hat on one [[profile]]. *The Sloth Hats, [[Crab Hat of Celebration|Crab Hats]], and the [[Pulse Ring]] are the only [[Accessory|Accessories]] that give {{stat|mf}} without [[Enrichments]]. *The amount of {{stat|int}} gained depends only on the number of [[Time|SkyBlock years]] that have passed since the player created their oldest profile, regardless of the player's activity during this time. The current maximum, which applies to players who joined during the first SkyBlock year, is {{SkyClock}}. * Despite one of Hypixel's owners being associated with sloths, this is the first Sloth themed item in the game. * [[Hatccessory|Hatccessories]] are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". * Sloth Hats come in 10 variants, while every other [[Hatcessory|Hatcessories]] only has 9. == Gallery ==
